title: Everything (by voidtools) — What it is
description: Everything by voidtools finds any file on a Windows PC the instant you type: it reads the NTFS USN change journal once at startup, keeps a tiny index in memory, and returns matches as fast as you can type, even across millions of files. For an AI workstation drowning in datasets, checkpoints and scripts, it is the fastest way to locate anything by name. It is freeware by David Carpenter and also ships an ETP/FTP/HTTP server for remote search. It is made by voidtools (David Carpenter) and runs on Windows.
facts: Advanced search operators include wildcards, size:, dm: (date modified), and path: filters.
The ETP protocol lets other machines query an Everything index over the network.
Everything 1.4.x is the long-standing stable line; 1.5a adds content indexing alphas.
